resources.string: On-device visual content safety observer using Android Accessibility screenshot APIs

Screen Guard observes active window changes and captures on-device accessibility screenshots in volatile memory to detect explicit imagery locally. Screenshots are never saved to disk or uploaded, and passwords or typed input are never collected. You can pause or disable Screen Guard at any time.

Optional administrator for Screen Guard. It can lock the screen on request and reports its activation state. It does not prevent uninstall, hide management, or block Android Settings. Deactivate it in Android Settings > Security > Device administrators.
